name: omp-cache-monitor
description: Cache hit-rate monitor and /cache-monitor command for OMP

omp.description: Prefix-cache hit rate, warnings, history and cost reports for OMP

statusEnabled.description: Show the cache hit rate in the status line. Applied to new sessions.

statusShowMode.description: Prefix the status with OMP_MODE. Applied to new sessions.

warningsEnabled.description: Enable cache miss warnings. Applied to new sessions.

lowHitPercent.description: Warn when a turn's cache hit is below this percent. Applied to new sessions.

idleMinutes.description: Gaps of at least this many minutes are reported as idle. Empirical heuristic, not a provider TTL. Applied to new sessions.

minPromptTokens.description: Do not warn on prompts smaller than this many tokens. Applied to new sessions.

historySize.description: Number of turns kept by /cache-monitor history. Applied to new sessions.

showMoney.description: Show saved / miss premium dollar amounts in reports and history. /cache-monitor costs always shows money. Applied to new sessions.
